name: Arei Tarou
source:
First year high school student. The way he refers to himself in the first-person, "boku" comes off as flirty.

Tarou is a quiet and inconspicuous student who looks as he could be anywhere. In fact, he is the reincarnation of a great magician who's said to be the strongest in the 20th century.

He has mastered the method of carrying over his memories to the next life, and has reincarnated repeatedly.

He regains his memories through the Book of Keys, which he entruested to [url=/c37955]Elena's[/url] grandfather, a disciple from his previous life.
He regains his memories through the Book of Keys, which he entrusted to Elena's grandfather, a disciple from his previous life.

When Tarou regains his memories, he is cunning and arrogant. He's also a seducer and a pervert.

He summons the lecherous demon siblings to embark on the research from his previous life: sexual magic.

[Translated from [url=https://digitalcute.com/cuterush/]the game's Official Homepage[/url].]
